title_protection.quote: to use, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human diseases or conditions in any printed material, stationery, letterhead, envelopes, signs, or advertisements, the designation "doctor," "doctor of medicine," "physician," "surgeon," "physician and surgeon," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination of these designations in any manner which might cause a reasonable person to believe the individual using the designation is a licensed physician and surgeon

scope_protection.quote: A license is required to engage in the practice of medicine, on or for any person in Utah, as a physician and surgeon, except as specifically provided in Section 58-1-307 or 58-67-305.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining any medical diploma, license, certificate, or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining, any medical diploma, license, certificate, or registration

disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding or abetting the buying, selling, or fraudulently obtaining of any medical diploma, license, certificate, or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substantially interfering with a licensee's lawful and competent practice of medicine by a person with financial interest or non-physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: substantially interfering with a licensee's lawful and competent practice of medicine in accordance with this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract that limits a licensee's ability to advise patients fully about treatment options
disciplinary_grounds.quote: entering into a contract that limits a licensee's ability to advise the licensee's patients fully about treatment options or other issues that affect the health care of the licensee's patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or employing services of any individual to assist a licensee in a manner not in accordance with recognized practices, standards, or ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using or employing the services of any individual to assist a licensee in any manner not in accordance with the generally recognized practices, standards, or ethics of the profession, state law, or division rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a material misrepresentation regarding qualifications for licensure under physician-educator or associate physician provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making a material misrepresentation regarding the qualifications for licensure under Section 58-67-302.7 or 58-67-302.8

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the dispensing requirements of the Dispensing Medical Practitioner chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating the dispensing requirements of Chapter 17b, Part 8, Dispensing Medical Practitioner and Dispensing Medical Practitioner Clinic Pharmacy, if applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the requirements of the Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis title
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating the requirements of Title 26B, Chapter 4, Part 2, Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or inducing an abortion in violation of statutory requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing or inducing an abortion in violation of the requirements of Section 76-7-302 or Section 76-7a-201, regardless of whether the individual licensed under this chapter is found guilty of a crime in connection with the violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with intent to conceal wrongful acts or omissions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (i) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or causing to be performed a primary or secondary sex characteristic surgical procedure on an individual under 18
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performing, or causing to be performed, upon an individual who is less than 18 years old: (i) a primary sex characteristic surgical procedure; or (ii) a secondary sex characteristic surgical procedure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must submit current ECFMG certification or complete the fifth pathway program, which requires passing ECFMG or USMLE Parts I and II, completing one year of supervised clinical training in a US accredited setting, and completing required postgraduate hospital training.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if the applicant graduated from a medical school or college located outside the United States or its territories, submitting a current certification by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or any successor organization approved by the division in collaboration with the board

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: An applicant for participation in the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact under Chapter 67b, Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, shall: (a) submit fingerprint cards in a form acceptable to the division

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Before a licensed associate physician may engage in the practice of medicine, the licensed associate physician shall: (a) enter into a collaborative practice arrangement described in Section 58-67-807

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Associate physicians may prescribe Schedule III through V controlled substances if authorized under a collaborative practice arrangement and registered with the DEA mid-level practitioner registry
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: if authorized under a collaborative practice arrangement to prescribe Schedule III through V controlled substances, shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration as part of the drug enforcement administration's mid-level practitioner registry

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A physician or surgeon may not enter into a collaborative practice arrangement with more than three full-time equivalent associate physicians.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: a record of professional liability claims made against the applicant and settlements paid by or on behalf of the applicant

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the division may not refuse, revoke, suspend, or in any way restrict an applicant or licensee's license under this chapter solely because the applicant or licensee seeks or participates in mental health or substance abuse treatment
impaired_physician_program_authorized.citation: Section 401 - Grounds for denial of license -- Disciplinary proceedings.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Every physician who accepts the privilege of being licensed under this chapter gives consent to: (i) submitting at the physician's own expense to an immediate mental or physical examination when directed in writing by the division and a majority of the board to do so
compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.citation: Section 601 - Mentally incompetent or incapacitated physician.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: in compliance with Section 58-85-103: (i) obtaining an investigational drug or investigational device; (ii) administering the investigational drug to an eligible patient; or (iii) treating an eligible patient with the investigational drug or investigational device
